Title: Inference-only model graph port

Description: For ROIs covering large % of frame, split into overlapping tiles (e.g., 256x256), restore each, then feather-blend tiles back to avoid extreme downscale artifacts.

Title: Robust PTS/timebase handling (VFR-safe mode)

Title: Overlap detection and restoration with CUDA streams
Description: Use separate CUDA streams (and events) to overlap YOLO and BasicVSR++ work where possible; profile to ensure net throughput gain without VRAM spikes.

Title: Remove redundant double mask OR in _compute_crop
Description: Eliminate the second seg_mask OR pass in _compute_crop (idempotent) to reduce clutter and avoid confusion in parity reviews.
